verify.subject: Confirm your email for Rendetto

alreadyRegistered.subject: You already have a Rendetto account

reset.subject: New password for Rendetto

passwordChanged.subject: Your Rendetto password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
The password of your account was just changed and all other sessions were signed out.

If it was not you, set a new password right away: {reset}

codeFailures.subject: Wrong sign-in codes on Rendetto
codeFailures.body:
Someone entered your correct password but not the right code from the authenticator app. After several failed attempts, signing in to your account is paused for 15 minutes.

If this was not you, someone else knows your password. Change it now: {reset}

newDevice.subject: Sign-in from a new device on Rendetto

twoFactorOn.subject: Two-factor protection is on
twoFactorOn.body:
Two-factor protection is now on for your Rendetto account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe.

If it was not you, change your password right away: {security}

twoFactorOff.subject: Two-factor protection is off
twoFactorOff.body:
Two-factor protection is now off for your Rendetto account.

If it was not you, change your password and turn it back on: {security}

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email for Rendetto

emailChangeNotice.subject: A change of your Rendetto email was requested
emailChangeNotice.body:
A change of your account's email to {email} was requested. The email changes only when the new address is confirmed.

If it was not you, change your password right away: {security}

trialEnding.subject: Your Rendetto trial ends in 3 days
trialEnding.body:
Your trial ends on {date}. After that your projects stay and can be downloaded, but new projects and changes need a plan.

Plans and prices: {plan}

planChanged.subject: Your Rendetto plan has changed

accountDeleted.subject: Your Rendetto account was deleted
accountDeleted.body:
Your account and all its projects have been deleted permanently.

If you did not ask for this, write to us at the address below.
